faq.q: How does a shop get a clip from a listing?
faq.a: Paste the public product page. After you approve the sentence, download the clip.

faq.q: Is there a charge to start from a link?
faq.a: Yes. Clips spend credits on a monthly plan. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. A clip uses 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. You see that number before it runs.

faq.q: What kinds of clips can a link become?
faq.a: A link can become the ad that names one fact, a clip that shows one action, or the post you put on a phone-shaped placement.
Yes. Use it when the next ad should come from the page you already keep up to date.

faq.q: Can I change the drafted script?
faq.a: Yes. If a draft disagrees with the page, keep the page's word before you finish the clip.

faq.q: Which file types and frames are available?
faq.a: Frames are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. The download has no watermark.

faq.q: What actually happens after I paste the page?
faq.a: The photo and the facts you already wrote are what the page contributes. You still approve the sentence before the clip is kept.
No. If you can copy the page address, you can start. The editor is there when you want to change a word or the music.
Use a product page a shopper can open without an account, including Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, and WordPress listings. If the page asks for a login, upload the photo instead.

faq.q: Why bother starting from the listing?
faq.a: Because the page is already maintained. The ad should not make you retype the facts and upload the photo again.

faq.q: What if I want it moving quickly?
faq.a: Paste the page, approve the drafted sentence, and export. That is the whole path when the page is already public.

faq.q: How long does the render take?
faq.a: You confirm the actor, the script, and the credits first. The 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds is the length of the video, not a wait you have to book.

faq.q: What is the simplest path from a listing to an ad?
faq.a: Paste the page and approve one sentence. Captions come with the file.

definition.title: What Is URL to Video?
paras: URL to video means a public product page becomes the spoken ad. The photo already on that page is the one the actor holds, along with the name and the points you wrote.

Edit the script, the captions, and the music before you download or publish. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Frames include square 1:1, wide 16:9, and tall 9:16, plus 4:3 and 3:4. The person on screen is an AI actor.

reviews.h2: How Shops Turn a Product Link Into an Ad
reviews.lead: How ten kinds of sellers start from one public listing. These are examples, not quotes.

items.d: A store seller pastes a public listing, checks the photo and the script, and shows one action of the product.
A gadget seller uses the stand's public page, picks an actor, and asks for one unfolding action so shoppers can see how it opens.
A store running ads takes the same listing, makes one paid post about a single point, and publishes it on Facebook or Instagram.
A social seller pastes the listing again, picks a tall 9:16 size, and posts it to TikTok, Instagram or YouTube Shorts.
A beauty shop lets the page's reviews into the script so the clip mentions what buyers already noticed.
A catalog seller pastes a handful of product links and makes one clip for each item in that sitting.
A wellness seller keeps the same product page and makes a second clip in another language for a new market.
A home shop picks an actor and a voice, then edits one line of the script before downloading.
A small team trims the clip, fixes a caption and swaps the music in the editor. Then they download a file with no logo stamped on it.
A drink seller sends the finished clip to TikTok from the same screen after checking how many credits it will use.
